partition: Exact decimal CSV User ID string hashed as SHA256(UTF8('rba-user:'+value)). Previously observed probe-user hashes always development. Otherwise first8 digest bytes as unsigned big-endian integer modulo100:0..69 development,70..84 calibration,85..99 reserved_candidate. Never reseed/reassign based on label support or model results.
label_scope: Count the three explicit publisher boolean fields separately and jointly; unknown stays unknown. No conversion of failed login/attack IP/ATO=false into generic six-domain threat/benign truth.
observation_scope: User support/partition, timestamp shape/ranges/order, field missingness and RTT validity only. Do not display/export case values or fit a model. Original user strings are transient, stored metadata uses user hashes only.
resource_bounds: Streaming CSV at most16GiB, physical line/field64KiB, SQLite metadata max1GiB with16MiB cache, bounded in-memory batch. No full CSV extraction. Verify archive before/after; claim member CRC only at full EOF with exact byte count.
limitations: User partitions do not certify physical-device, request-template, exact-event or future-time independence. Aggregate reserved-candidate label support may be audited but no final per-case predictions/labels are shown or used to fit/tune a classifier. All final eligibility remains unproven.
